g.text: L A U N C H N E W H O M E P A G E
Build component library (▲3d), Optimize image assets (in 6d)
Go-live plan, agreed with marketing and support on Sep 22.
Feature-flag the new homepage for internal users first, then 10 % of
traffic for one full business day while we watch conversion, error rate
and the p95 of the checkout page against last week.
Lower the DNS TTL to 300 seconds two days before the cut-over so a
rollback propagates in minutes, not hours.
Support gets the FAQ and the macro set one week before; the status page
draft is written in advance and kept unpublished.
Rollback: flip the flag, restore the old sitemap, purge the CDN. The
